title: Introduce token-latency-facet and log-condenser for high-cardinality tail analysis
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: We need better visibility into high-cardinality token-level latency outliers that are currently masked by per-invocation aggregates. This PR introduces two complementary observability pieces: (1) token-latency-facet, a compact per-invocation histogram-rollup that captures token-phase latencies (prefix, decode, kv-lookup, kernel, network) with keyed facets for prompt-shape and model-variant; and (2) log-condenser, a lightweight event coalescer that attaches condensed log snippets and span anchors for the top-k slow tokens per invocation to reduce cardinality and noise while preserving debug context. Goals: enable SRE and runtime engineers to diagnose long-tail latency regressions quickly, surface token-level cost/latency correlations, and provide actionable alerting signals without exploding metric cardinality. What changed: - telemetry: added token_latency_facet histogram metric (labels: tenant_id, model_family, prompt_shape_bucket, token_phase) with compressed quantile rollups; added token_tail_count gauge to track number of tokens above phase-specific thresholds per invocation - tracing: span enrichment that attaches token_phase and facet_bucket tags to existing model-io spans and emits a compact token_anchor span for the slowest token per invocation - logging: log-condenser service that subscribes to the invocation event stream, samples top-k slow tokens, and produces a condensed payload (max 2 log lines + 3 surrounding tokens) written to a bounded artifact store; payloads are cross-referenced by token_anchor_id in traces - dashboards/alerts: new Token Latency Facet dashboard with phase heatmap, tenant-level top-k tails, and a Cost vs Latency scatter; alert rule updated to add token_tail_rate (auto-muted for low-volume tenants) and an adaptive dampener that uses sessionization to avoid alerting on single noisy invocations Backwards compatibility and performance: metric additions are additive; histograms use reservoir sampling and exponential decimation to keep cardinality and storage bounded. The log-condenser runs as an independently scaled service to avoid impacting request path. Rollout plan: staged feature-flag rollout (off by default) to 20% of tenants for 48 hours, evaluate token_tail_rate signal, then 100% with a 7-day quiet window. We will enable span enrichment for Dedicated clusters only during initial rollout. Testing: unit tests for histogram encoding and span tag propagation; integration run against synthetic heavy-invocation harness to validate throughput; e2e smoke on staging with sample dashboard panels. Operational notes: - Adds config knobs: token_facet_sample_rate, token_phase_thresholds, log_condenser_max_k - Monitoring added for log-condenser: input lag, condensation ratio, store errors and retention - SLO impact: no user-visible behavior change; the new metrics are covered by a temporary retention and cost guard. Related work: builds on ENG-3120 (sessionized spans) and complements ENG-3681 (token cost attribution). Linear tasks: ENG-3412 (implementation), ENG-3489 (dashboards + alerts). Risks and mitigations: risk of metric-cardinality spike mitigated by sampling decimation and auto-mute; risk of expensive log retention mitigated by bounded condensed payload and TTL; debugging complexity mitigated by linking token_anchor_id across traces, metrics and condensed logs. Merge notes: squash-merged after approvals and a green CI run. Release notes: Adds Token Latency Facet telemetry and Log Condenser service to aid long-tail latency investigations; feature guarded and disabled by default.

perf: reservoir sampler and quantile encoder for token histograms

review_comments: Marco Liu: Please add a short section in docs/playbooks explaining how to correlate token_anchor_id with raw logs and traces.
Priya Desai: Added playbook section and inline example showing trace->metric->condensed-log correlation.
Anya Patel: Can we auto-mute token_tail_rate for tenants with <100 invocations/day? Suggest adding the threshold to config and documenting default behavior.
Priya Desai: Added auto-mute configuration and updated the alert rule; included default of 100 invocations/day and a 24h warmup.
Samir Rao: Load tested the condenser at 5x expected peak; noticed a spike in store-latency when retention was set to 30d. Recommend initial 7d TTL.
Priya Desai: Reduced default TTL to 7d and added store latency metrics with backpressure logging.
release_notes: Introduces Token Latency Facet (compact per-invocation token-phase histograms) and a Log Condenser that captures condensed token-level log snippets for the slowest tokens. Guarded behind feature flags; rollout to 20% then 100% as described in playbook. Adds new dashboards and an adaptive token_tail_rate alert (auto-mute for low-volume tenants).
